summary_en: Ursa 4 to acquire remaining shares at ¥9,000/share and warrants at ¥1,735,000/warrant via squeeze-out. Ursa 4 holds 92.91% post-tender-offer (19,737,531 shares as of 2026-08-03). Settlement date 2026-09-04. Delisting 2026-09-02.
title_en: Notice of Share Tender Demand by Ursa 4 K.K. against J.S.B. Co., Ltd. Securities, Approval of Share Tender Demand, and Notice regarding Delisting of J.S.B. Co., Ltd. Shares
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-10, J.S.B. Co., Ltd. received notice from Ursa 4 K.K. (its parent company holding 92.91% of outstanding shares as of 2026-08-03 settlement) that Ursa 4 would exercise a statutory squeeze-out demand under Companies Act Article 179 against all minority shareholders and warrant-holders, excluding J.S.B. and Ursa 4 themselves. J.S.B.'s board approved the demand the same day. Under the squeeze-out, all remaining ordinary shares will be acquired at ¥9,000 per share and all warrants at ¥1,735,000 per warrant, with settlement scheduled for 2026-09-04. The acquisition is part of a transaction to make J.S.B. a wholly-owned subsidiary of Ursa 4. Following board approval, J.S.B. shares will be designated as delisting-category securities from 2026-08-10 to 2026-09-01, and will be delisted from the Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market effective 2026-09-02. The minority shareholders and warrant-holders affected (approximately 1.43 million shares at ¥9,000 = ¥12.87 billion in aggregate consideration) represent the remainder after Ursa 4's post-tender-offer stake.
